training.data_named: 20 million video pairs from general T2V corpora; ~30 million image pairs from tutorial videos; OmniCorpus interleaved data; UniREdit-100K, Pico-Banana-400K, OpenS2V-Top200K, Senorita-Controllable, SyncamVideo, TrajectoryCrafter, CameraClone, VACE-HQ; in-house T2I, T2V and I2I data; constructed editing, R2V, motion-transfer and CoT data

main_sampler.description: MLLM planner: masked generative decoding of target ViT embeddings over 25 planning steps (5 flow-matching steps of the ViT embedding decoder per step, text/image guidance 1.2/1.0); DiT renderer: flow-matching denoising, 40 steps for V2V, flow shift 5.0, multi-condition CFG with adaptive projected guidance

credited_component.text: Bernini: MLLM's own ViT embedding space as semantic bridge to the diffusion generator

design.other_detail: D02: planner masks a Beta-sampled ratio of target ViT tokens with a shared mask token (task-dependent alpha, beta) and predicts masked tokens by per-token flow matching; renderer uses flow matching on VAE latents with logit-normal/mode timestep sampling. D07: planner fills masked ViT tokens over 25 steps with a cosine mask schedule (position rule not stated); renderer updates all latent positions each step.
design.inherited_from: Wan2.2-A14B (renderer channel, predictor, revision); Qwen2.5-VL-7B (text generation); MaskGIT/MAR masked generative paradigm [8, 43] (D07)

census.F2_detail: Flow-matching renderer with multi-condition CFG (V2V: ωtxt 4.0, ωvid 1.25, ωimg 1.25, ωtgt 0.5, Table 5) plus adaptive projected guidance; planner ViT-decoder guidance text 1.2, image 1.0; no temperature or per-step sampling rule stated; user instruction rewritten by an extra MLLM by default.

setting.sampler_printed: DiT-based renderer flow-matching denoising; 25 iterative planning steps
setting.guidance_printed: ωtxt 4.0, ωvid 1.25, ωimg 1.25, ωtgt 0.5; adaptive projected guidance
